title: Food Safety No Fridge
description: Plain-text reference on the temperature danger zone, how long refrigerated and frozen food stays safe without power, and what to discard. Covers cooler and ice strategies, shelf-stable substitutes, preserving without electricity, cooking temperatures, and the 2-hour rule.
shortDescription: How long fridge and freezer food lasts in an outage, and what to toss
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
